blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Are you one of the many who avoid sunscr
blocks_element.text:
Are you one of the many who avoid sunscreen because of its shiny, greasy finish? We understand the struggle – traditional SPFs can feel heavy and leave a noticeable shine on the skin, making them less than ideal for everyday wear.

If this is you, we are excited to introduce you to the solution you've been searching for: meet our Matte Universal Tinted Moisturizer SPF 46, the newest addition to our SPF lineup. Specifically crafted for those who shy away from sunscreen due to its heavy feel, our tinted SPF offers the perfect compromise. It's lightweight, oil-absorbing, and provides sheer coverage that feels like a second skin.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Formulated almost identically to our ori
blocks_element.text: Formulated almost identically to our original #1 best-seller Universal Tinted Moisturizer SPF 46, but with a matte finish, this lightweight tint is designed to even out your complexion without the shine. No more compromising between having sun protection or greasy, oily skin.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · It's more than just a sunscreen. So, wha
blocks_element.text: It's more than just a sunscreen. So, what sets our Matte Universal Tinted Moisturizer apart?

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Nourishing Hydration: Infused with a ble
blocks_element.text: Nourishing Hydration: Infused with a blend of hydrating ingredients, including hyaluronic acid and vitamin E, this tinted moisturizer quenches your skin's thirst, leaving it feeling supple and refreshed.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Skin-Boosting Benefits: With a high conc
blocks_element.text: Skin-Boosting Benefits: With a high concentration of niacinamide (vitamin B3), our tinted sunscreen goes beyond simple coverage. It actively works to improve your skin's texture, minimize pores, and even out your complexion for a flawless, velvety finish.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Broad Spectrum Protection: Shield your s
blocks_element.text: Broad Spectrum Protection: Shield your skin from harmful UV rays, infrared radiation, and blue light with our broad spectrum SPF 46. Whether you're soaking up the sun or spending hours in front of your screen, rest assured knowing your skin is protected.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Seamless Blending: Our unique formula se
blocks_element.text: Seamless Blending: Our unique formula seamlessly blends into all skin tones, adapting to your natural complexion for a perfect match every time. No more guessing games or color mismatches – just sheer, natural-looking coverage that enhances your skin.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Lightweight Feel: Say goodbye to heavy,
blocks_element.text:
Lightweight Feel: Say goodbye to heavy, cakey makeup. Our lightweight formula feels weightless on your skin, allowing it to breathe while still providing the coverage you desire.

Matte Finish: The perfect sunscreen for those who have oily & combination skin or simply warmer months of the year. In warmer climates, the skin produces more oil, making it an ideal essential for summer.

Zinc Oxide 12%
Gentle, mineral sunscreen ingredient that reflects UVA & UVB rays providing high-quality broad spectrum protection.

Hyaluronic Acid
Absorbs and retains moisture, boosts hydration, and plumps up dry, dull skin.

Niacinamide
Also known as vitamin b3, minimizes pore appearance, evens skin tone, and restores moisture loss.

Vitamin E
A soothing antioxidant that helps defend against environmental stressors and aging.

Knotweed Extract
Antioxidant that helps inhibit glycation, which causes wrinkles and loss of firmness and elasticity.

blocks_element.text:
Tired of foundation settling into fine lines, accentuating wrinkles, and making you feel less confident? It's time for a change.

Our Matte Universal Tinted Moisturizer SPF 46 offers a simplified solution, effortlessly blending hydration, sun protection, and sheer coverage into one simple step.

Eliminate the hassle of layering multiple products and hello to a streamlined morning routine that leaves you looking and feeling refreshed.

By opting for our tinted moisturizer, you not only enhance your skin's natural radiance but also minimize the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles and prevent premature aging.

It's the ultimate multitasker that simplifies your skincare and makeup routine, allowing you to embrace the beauty of natural, luminous skin without the heaviness of traditional foundation.

You'll fall in love with your skin again when you add Matte Universal Tinted Moisturizer SPF 46 to your routine. Trust us, your skin will thank you for it!
